description: This Java class handles update commands for payment types within the Fineract system. It implements command processing by invoking the PaymentTypeWriteService to perform the update operation based on the received JsonCommand.

classes.name: UpdatePaymentTypeCommandHandler
classes.description: A command handler class that processes update commands for payment types. It uses annotations to define the command type and is managed as a Spring service. Its core method processes incoming JsonCommand objects to update payment types via the PaymentTypeWriteService.

methods.name: UpdatePaymentTypeCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the PaymentTypeWriteService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming JsonCommand to update a payment type using the PaymentTypeWriteService.
